business.tagline: Fast, Reliable Key Duplication & Spare Keys in Balham
business.businessDescription: Balham Key Cutting provides fast, professional, and reliable key duplication in Balham, South London. From cylinder front door keys to mortice locks, commercial blanks, and spare tenant sets, our dedicated workshop guarantees accurate, smooth-fitting keys cut while you wait.
business.directionsHelp: Conveniently located on Balham High Road, just a short walk from Balham Tube & National Rail Station. Quick stops welcome.

services.name: Key Duplication
services.shortDescription: Fast and accurate duplicate keys for everyday residential and commercial use.
services.fullDescription: Our calibrated cutting machinery duplicates standard cylinder and edge-cut keys in minutes. Perfect for having a working twin of your primary keys cut with tight tolerances for smooth turning in the lock.

services.name: House Keys
services.shortDescription: Duplicate standard residential keys quickly and accurately for front and back doors.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive range of residential door blanks including Yale, ERA, Union, and universal cylinder keys. Ideal for family members, cleaners, and regular household access.

services.name: Spare Keys
services.shortDescription: Create reliable spare keys for your home, family, trusted neighbours or tenants.
services.fullDescription: Never get locked out in Balham again. Duplicate a trusted spare set for trusted neighbors, emergency key safes, Airbnb hosts, or estate agent handovers.
features: Key rings and color tags available

services.name: Office & Business Keys
services.shortDescription: Key duplication for local shops, offices, commercial properties, and desk units.
services.fullDescription: Reliable duplication for office doors, shutter padlocks, internal security grilles, desk pedestals, filing cabinets, and staff access keys.

services.name: Replacement Keys
services.shortDescription: Professional replacement key cutting for suitable key types and worn originals.
services.fullDescription: If your existing key is slightly worn or difficult to turn in the barrel, our skilled cutters can decode and cut a fresh, clean duplicate with corrected pin depths.

services.name: Mortice & Chubb Keys
services.shortDescription: Traditional 5-lever deadlock and mortice keys cut with exacting precision.
services.fullDescription: High-security British Standard mortice deadlock keys, 3-lever and 5-lever Chubb style keys cut on specialist heavy-duty bit-cutting machines.
features: Solid brass and steel bit blanks

services.name: Padlock & Locker Keys
services.shortDescription: Duplicates for gym lockers, bike D-locks, shed padlocks, and storage units.
services.fullDescription: Keep your valuables accessible. We stock small brass padlock blanks, post box keys, luggage keys, and heavy security chain keys.

openingHours.holidayNotice: Open as normal during bank holidays unless stated. Walk-ins welcome anytime during trading hours.

testimonials.reviewText: Popped in on my way back from Balham station with two tricky mortice keys that another high street place cut poorly. Balham Key Cutting did them in under ten minutes and both turned like butter on first try.
Needed emergency spares for our Airbnb apartment in Balham. Fast, courteous, and very fair local price. Will definitely return whenever we need duplicate keys.
Proper local shop. Quick counter service, knowledgeable advice on our older patio lock, and took 3 minutes while I waited. Highly recommended.
